mapper.select: SELECT * FROM telemetry_alarm_preset WHERE is_global = 1 OR floor_code = #{floorCode} OR floor_code IS NULL ORDER BY is_global DESC, name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telemetry_alarm_preset (name, description, floor_code, temp_min, temp_max, hum_min, hum_max, pressure_min, pressure_max, hysteresis_temp, hysteresis_hum, hysteresis_pressure, alarm_cooldown_minutes, is_global) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{floorCode}, #{tempMin}, #{tempMax}, #{humMin}, #{humMax}, #{pressureMin}, #{pressureMax}, #{hysteresisTemp}, #{hysteresisHum}, #{hysteresisPressure}, #{alarmCooldownMinutes}, #{isGlobal})
mapper.update: UPDATE telemetry_alarm_preset SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, floor_code = #{floorCode}, temp_min = #{tempMin}, temp_max = #{tempMax}, hum_min = #{humMin}, hum_max = #{humMax}, pressure_min = #{pressureMin}, pressure_max = #{pressureMax}, hysteresis_temp = #{hysteresisTemp}, hysteresis_hum = #{hysteresisHum}, hysteresis_pressure = #{hysteresisPressure}, alarm_cooldown_minutes = #{alarmCooldownMinutes}, is_global = #{isGlobal} WHERE id = #{id}
